title: Cool AI Sh*t — Baltimore Summit 2025
summary: The inaugural summit convened nonprofit leaders, technologists, creatives, and advocates to explore context-aware AI, ethical responsibility, and authenticity amid automation. The community surfaced productive tensions and a shared commitment to shaping AI’s future together.

title: Cool/Scary AI Impact — Denver Summit 2025
summary: The Denver summit focused on moving nonprofits from AI anxiety to intentional action. Speakers explored human judgment, ethical guardrails, and inclusive design while embracing contradictions like innovation versus regulation.

title: Cool/Scary AI Sh!t — Brooklyn Summit 2025
summary: The Brooklyn summit centered on culture-first AI adoption for mission-driven organizations. Sessions highlighted practical automation, data foundations, and adaptive ethics as prerequisites for responsible scale.

title: Cool/Scary AI × DC Public Library — Neighborhood Editions
summary: Three neighborhood conversations with DC Public Library at Mt. Pleasant, Woodridge, and Anacostia. Residents weren't afraid of AI itself — they worried about what we'll stop doing for ourselves: judgment, craft, kids' resilience, and the connections we make when we need each other.

title: Cool/Scary AI Impact Forum — San Francisco
summary: The San Francisco forum convened technologists, funders, and community advocates to examine AI's transformative potential alongside its risks, with a focus on accountability, equity, and who gets to shape these systems.

title: Cool/Scary AI Sh!t — Washington, DC
summary: A frank, community-led conversation in the nation's capital about the realities of AI adoption — the promising, the problematic, and the unresolved. Participants explored policy implications, organizational readiness, and the human stakes of getting it wrong.
